about: Every skill of the product, the model that runs it, and the tools it may use. A skill is a prompt and an output schema for one job. A tool is something a model may ask for; code decides whether it exists and runs it. All tools are read-only. tests/docs.test.ts checks this file against the code.

skills.name: plan-queries
skills.job: Writes the search queries for the first search of a chat answer.

skills.name: ask
skills.job: Writes the checked answer in the chat: steps with a page and a quote each, suggested checks, a hazard flag, figures.

skills.name: voice-guide
skills.job: Leads the live call: listens, speaks, walks the technician through one step at a time.

skills.name: rerank
skills.job: Orders the sections a search found by how well they answer the question, and drops the rest.

skills.name: look
skills.job: Looks at one camera picture: finds a named part, what a finger points at, or answers what is visible.

skills.name: identify
skills.job: Sample fault trees: classifies a fault from a picture or a description.

skills.name: interpret
skills.job: Sample fault trees: reads a free-text reply as yes, no or unclear.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.does: Searches the knowledge base by keywords and meaning.

tools.name: read_pages
tools.does: Returns the page after one the agent already has.

tools.name: answer_from_manual
tools.does: Searches the manual for the technician's question and returns the sections that answer it, with the hazard caution.

tools.name: mark_on_picture
tools.does: Circles a named part, or what a finger points at, on the live picture.

tools.name: look_at_picture
tools.does: Answers a question about what the camera picture shows.
